args.sql_query:
-- Comprehensive analysis of highest sales
WITH main_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(highest_sales_flag) as max_sales,
    MIN(highest_sales_flag) as min_sales,
    AVG(highest_sales_flag) as avg_sales,
    MEDIAN(highest_sales_flag) as median_sales,
    COUNT(*) as total_transactions,
    SUM(highest_sales_flag) as total_sales
  FROM sales_analysis
),
highest_sale_details AS (
  SELECT 
    transaction_id,
    transaction_date,
    product_name,
    category,
    store_name,
    city,
    state,
    region,
    quantity,
    unit_price,
    highest_sales_flag as total_sales,
    customer_segment,
    payment_method
  FROM sales_analysis
  WHERE highest_sales_flag = (SELECT MAX(highest_sales_flag) FROM sales_analysis)
  LIMIT 1
),
top_10_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    transaction_id,
    product_name,
    store_name,
    city,
    state,
    quantity,
    unit_price,
    highest_sales_flag as total_sales,
    customer_segment,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY highest_sales_flag DESC) as rank_num
  FROM sales_analysis
  ORDER BY highest_sales_flag DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
category_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    category,
    COUNT(*) as transaction_count,
    SUM(highest_sales_flag) as total_sales,
    AVG(highest_sales_flag) as avg_sales,
    MAX(highest_sales_flag) as max_sales
  FROM sales_analysis
  GROUP BY category
  ORDER BY total_sales DESC
),
store_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    store_name,
    city,
    state,
    region,
    COUNT(*) as transaction_count,
    SUM(highest_sales_flag) as total_sales,
    AVG(highest_sales_flag) as avg_sales,
    MAX(highest_sales_flag) as max_sales
  FROM sales_analysis
  GROUP BY store_name, city, state, region
  ORDER BY total_sales DESC
)
SELECT 
  'MAIN_STATS' as query_type,
  CAST(max_sales AS VARCHAR) as col1,
  CAST(min_sales AS VARCHAR) as col2,
  CAST(avg_sales AS VARCHAR) as col3,
  CAST(median_sales AS VARCHAR) as col4,
  CAST(total_transactions AS VARCHAR) as col5,
  CAST(total_sales AS VARCHAR) as col6,
  NULL as col7,
  NULL as col8,
  NULL as col9,
  NULL as col10
FROM main_stats
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'HIGHEST_SALE_DETAIL' as query_type,
  transaction_id as col1,
  CAST(transaction_date AS VARCHAR) as col2,
  product_name as col3,
  category as col4,
  store_name as col5,
  city as col6,
  state as col7,
  region as col8,
  CAST(quantity AS VARCHAR) as col9,
  CAST(unit_price AS VARCHAR) as col10
FROM highest_sale_details
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'HIGHEST_SALE_DETAIL2' as query_type,
  CAST(total_sales AS VARCHAR) as col1,
  customer_segment as col2,
  payment_method as col3,
  NULL as col4,
  NULL as col5,
  NULL as col6,
  NULL as col7,
  NULL as col8,
  NULL as col9,
  NULL as col10
FROM highest_sale_details

SELECT 
  transaction_id,
  product_name,
  store_name,
  city,
  state,
  quantity,
  ROUND(unit_price, 2) as unit_price,
  ROUND(highest_sales_flag, 2) as total_sales,
  customer_segment
FROM sales_analysis
ORDER BY highest_sales_flag DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  category,
  COUNT(*) as transaction_count,
  ROUND(SUM(highest_sales_flag), 2) as total_sales,
  ROUND(AVG(highest_sales_flag), 2) as avg_sales,
  ROUND(MAX(highest_sales_flag), 2) as max_sales
FROM sales_analysis
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY total_sales DESC

SELECT 
  store_name,
  city,
  state,
  region,
  COUNT(*) as transaction_count,
  ROUND(SUM(highest_sales_flag), 2) as total_sales,
  ROUND(AVG(highest_sales_flag), 2) as avg_sales,
  ROUND(MAX(highest_sales_flag), 2) as max_sales
FROM sales_analysis
GROUP BY store_name, city, state, region
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN UPPER(category) LIKE '%ELECTR%' THEN 'Electronics'
    WHEN UPPER(category) LIKE '%BEAUTY%' OR UPPER(category) LIKE '%COSMETIC%' THEN 'Beauty'
    WHEN UPPER(category) LIKE '%HOME%' OR UPPER(category) LIKE '%KITCHEN%' THEN 'Home & Kitchen'
    WHEN UPPER(category) LIKE '%APPAREL%' OR UPPER(category) LIKE '%CLOTHING%' THEN 'Apparel'
    WHEN UPPER(category) LIKE '%SPORT%' THEN 'Sports'
    ELSE category
  END as category_clean,
  COUNT(*) as transaction_count,
  ROUND(SUM(highest_sales_flag), 2) as total_sales,
  ROUND(AVG(highest_sales_flag), 2) as avg_sales,
  ROUND(MAX(highest_sales_flag), 2) as max_sales
FROM sales_analysis
GROUP BY category_clean
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
